BiblicalUsage: Kinah is a package, a bundle of wares. Jeremiah 10:17 tells the inhabitant of the fortress to gather up her wares out of the land, because the siege is coming.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the single verse is a whole sermon: when judgment comes, all you can carry is what you can bundle, and the rest stays behind.
